subject: Please waive bandwidth overage
body:
Hi Fernway team,

One of our posts went viral in October and our November invoice has a $120 bandwidth overage on top of the plan. That's more than the plan itself. Can you waive it? Account FW-10045.

Thanks,
Felix

refund.reason: overage from customer traffic is not refundable

policy_points: declines the refund because traffic overages are not refundable
suggests a spend cap or usage alerts
